sentences.text: This creature belongs to a group of early crocodile relatives known as sphenosuchians.
Later analysis revealed the main fossil specimen was actually a young individual, indicated by open joints in its neck bones.
Its skull is mostly intact but damaged by poor preservation and artificial holes made during cleaning.
It lived during the Norian stage, between 227.3 and 205.7 million years ago.
A 2002 study found its evolutionary position unresolved, placing it neither near true crocodiles nor Sphenosuchus.
